authority: Current explicit parent conveys user instruction
publication_checks: Necessary deployment/package/identity/availability checks only; reuse exact unchanged accepted model/source evidence. No duplicate model acceptance or aesthetic/factual QA at release.
identity_guard: Match exact batch, four IDs, source and each GLB hash; wrong-subject reply is invalid, not a completed model review.
changes_or_real_defects: No automatic second full model review. Report actual defect or changed hash to parent for necessary scoped resolution; do not reuse mismatched/stale evidence or fabricate PASS.
historical_contract_boundary: Frozen static profile and integrity/provenance checks retained; workflow does not add a second model-acceptance gate.
